meta.name: claude-mem-install
meta.description: Use this when setting up claude-mem on Cursor: local or remote worker, local host-login observer or remote cmem.ai inference.

copy.tagline: 在 Cursor 中完成本地或远程的记忆服务配置，让 AI 助手记住上下文。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在 Cursor 里编程，希望 AI 助手能跨会话记住内容。
copy.tagline_en: Set up a memory service for Cursor with local or remote options.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code in Cursor and want your AI assistant to remember context.

howto.what: 装上后,它会在 Cursor 里安装并启动 claude-mem 的本地或远程 worker,MCP(claude-mem-local 或 claude-mem-remote)随之接上记忆服务,observer 默认走 cmem.ai 远程推理,也可改成用本机登录。
howto.when: 当你要在 Cursor 上安装、配置 claude-mem(本地或远程 worker)时接管。

say.text: 帮我在 Cursor 里装 claude-mem 本地 worker
把 claude-mem 的 observer 改成用本机登录
把 claude-mem 接到我的远程服务器

howto.what_en: After install, it sets up claude-mem on Cursor and starts a local or remote worker; the MCP endpoint (claude-mem-local or claude-mem-remote) connects to the memory service. The observer defaults to cmem.ai remote inference, or can use local host-login.
howto.when_en: Use it when setting up claude-mem on Cursor, with a local or remote worker.

say_en.text: Install claude-mem local worker in Cursor for me
Switch claude-mem observer to local host-login
Connect claude-mem to my remote server
